svg.title: External resources and cache
svg.desc: The NVD mirror supplies CNA and CPE records. CISA KEV and EPSS supply risk data. Advisory sites supply link checks. Hugging Face supplies model weights. Trowl checks the cache first and fetches missing or stale data before use. No-network scans use cached CVE records and skip scores and links. Cached model weights run the local summary.
